title: The Agent Adoption Playbook: Getting Teams to Actually Use AI
author: Jason D.
excerpt: Building the agent is half the battle. Getting your team to trust and use it daily is the other half. Here's our adoption framework.
content:
You can build the most accurate, fastest, most reliable AI agent in the world. If your team doesn't use it, none of that matters.

We've seen it happen repeatedly: great agents that sit unused because the rollout was an afterthought.

The Adoption Framework

Phase 1: Shadow Mode

The agent runs alongside humans but doesn't take action. Humans see the agent's suggestions and compare to their own decisions. This builds familiarity and surfaces concerns.

Phase 2: Assisted Mode

The agent makes recommendations, and humans approve or reject them. The agent learns from the feedback, and humans build trust.

Phase 3: Autonomous with Review

The agent handles routine cases autonomously. A sample of decisions is reviewed. Exceptions are escalated.

Phase 4: Full Operations

The agent operates independently within its defined scope. Monitoring and weekly reviews continue.

Adoption Anti-Patterns

  • Big bang launch — Switching from manual to AI overnight. Resistance is guaranteed.
  • No training — Assuming the agent is self-explanatory.
  • No feedback channel — Users can't report issues or concerns easily.
  • No champion — No one on the operations team owns the relationship with the agent.

Adoption is a human problem, not a technology problem. Treat it with the same rigor you treat the engineering.

The Bottom Line

Plan for adoption from day one. Phase the rollout. Train the team. Create feedback loops. Assign an owner. The best agent is the one your team actually uses.
